Nicolas Finazzo, Chief Executive Officer at AerSale, stated, “The initiatives we have undertaken since early 2025 to make inventory and Flight Assets ready for sale or lease, optimize our sales force, invest in technology, and complete major facilities expansion projects, are taking hold.
Finazzo continued, “We enter the fourth quarter with a well-defined Flight Equipment pipeline expected to close before year end.
Together with our expanded lease portfolio and a clear path to monetizing the inventory we have built, we expect a significantly stronger fourth quarter.”
The Company was awarded seven A330 airframes, which meet our return requirements, with the first airframe anticipated to close in the coming weeks.

We have significantly optimized our management and sales organization to market our diverse service and product offerings with a full-service approach and an emphasis on cross selling, which we expect to improve performance in 2027.
As recently deployed B757 freighters continue to be integrated into operations, the Company expects leasing margins to improve as 757 utilization increases and additional engines are placed on lease.
